title: Strong Gaussian Approximation of Constant-Learning-Rate SGD: Bias and Trajectory Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.14567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops strong Gaussian approximations (KMT type) for constant learning rate stochastic gradient descent (SGD). We work with heavy tailed noise and assume that the number of iterates grows and the learning rate shrinks simultaneously. Our work constructs simple Gaussian processes on the same space and bounds, in probability, the maximum difference between the SGD errors and their respective limits. While there exist central limit theorems for constant rate SGD centered at the optimum, these only provide individual iterate inference. By contrast, our quenched KMT approximations allow for finite sample, simultaneous, whole-trajectory-level inference and imply stochastic process convergence (Functional Central Limit Theorems (FCLTs)). translated_title: 常学习率随机梯度下降的强高斯逼近：偏差与轨迹推断
translated_abstract: 本文为常学习率随机梯度下降（SGD）建立了强高斯逼近（KMT型逼近）。我们在重尾噪声的情形下开展工作，并假设迭代次数增长与学习率收缩同时进行。我们的工作在同一概率空间上构造了简单的高斯过程，并以概率方式界定了SGD误差与其各自极限之间的最大差异。尽管目前已存在以最优点为中心的常学习率SGD的中心极限定理，但这些定理仅能提供单个迭代点的推断。相比之下，我们的淬火型（quenched）KMT逼近能够实现有限样本下同时性的、整个轨迹层面的推断，并蕴含随机过程的收敛性（即泛函中心极限定理FCLT）。对于以真实最优点为中心的累积误差，当学习率满足 $\gamma_n=\frac{c}{\sqrt n}+o(n^{-1/2})$（其中 $c$ 为常数）时，我们首先得到了KMT型逼近界。
tldr: 本文为重尾噪声下的常学习率随机梯度下降建立了KMT型强高斯逼近，实现了有限样本下同时性的整个轨迹层面的推断，并蕴含泛函中心极限定理。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes KMT-type strong Gaussian approximations for constant-learning-rate SGD under heavy-tailed noise, enabling finite-sample, simultaneous, whole-trajectory-level inference and implying functional central limit theorems.
